name: Hungary

income_tax.summary: Flat 15% personal income tax on nearly all income; independent-activity income counts at 90% of gross or gross minus deductible costs; family and other allowances exist. Employee social security contribution 18.5% of gross, no cap stated (minimum wage HUF 322,800 a month from 1 Jan 2026).
income_tax.self_employed_notes: Recorded 31.5% = 18.5% social security contribution (NAV payable-contributions page; stated for insured persons generally) plus 13% social contribution tax (szocho, NAV rate table), both applied to the sole trader's contribution base. The base is NOT confirmed: NAV states that from 1 Jan 2026 the monthly minimum base for full-time sole traders is 100% of the minimum wage or guaranteed wage minimum (HUF 322,800 a month, HUF 3,873,600 a year, so a minimum of about HUF 1.22m a year at 31.5%); how the base is set for flat-rate (atalanyado) traders and any cap were not found, so the effective rate on EUR 54,000 and EUR 130,000 is unverified. KATA is limited since 1 Sep 2022 to full-time sole proprietors whose income is only from private individuals (HUF 50,000 a month standard, ceiling HUF 18m); a revival is announced but not enacted. The flat-rate regime (atalanyado) has a 45% cost ratio for 2026 (50% in 2027), VAT exemption threshold HUF 20m. Employee social_security_deductible: PwC Hungary lists only family and age allowances, no contribution deduction; the figure rests on a secondary guide, so treat as medium confidence.
income_tax.local_tax_note: No local income tax in the PwC page.

regimes.name: White Card (digital nomad residence permit)
regimes.description: Residence permit for non-EEA remote workers with a foreign employer or foreign company income of at least EUR 3,000 NET a month for at least six months before entry and throughout the stay (OIF factsheet, official; a secondary guide says gross, the official source governs). No gainful activity in Hungary and no shares in a Hungarian company. Valid up to 1 year, extendable once for 1 year (extension needs 90 days of stay in the prior 180). Family members generally cannot get a reunification permit. Under 183 days a year the holder is not Hungarian tax-resident per a secondary guide; as a resident the flat 15% applies. The OIF factsheet contains no tax statement.
regimes.duration_note: Up to 1 year plus one extension of 1 year (OIF factsheet); extension needs 90 days of stay in the prior 180 days.

sources.title: White Card - residency for digital nomads (OIF factsheet)

regimes.name: Flat-rate tax (atalanyado) for sole traders
regimes.description: Sole traders may deduct a fixed share of revenue instead of actual costs: 45% in 2026, 50% in 2027, so 55% of revenue is taxable at the normal 15% rate. VAT exemption threshold HUF 20 million for 2026.

residence_routes: EU citizens may live and work freely. US and other non-EEA remote workers can use the White Card (up to 2 years in total); skilled employees need a work-based permit (e.g. guest worker or Hungarian Card), which was not researched from an official page.
